title: GraveGain2D
description: A dark fantasy action RPG featuring emoji-based visuals, 2.5D lighting, procedural dungeons, dialogue system, and a starship management hub. v2.0.0 adds the AAA presentation layer with full 10-mission campaign parity: cinematic layer intros, killstreak announcer, boss cinematics with slow-mo slays, objective tracker, tutorials, run stats, and adaptive audio.

maker.name: Antigravity Dev
maker.bio: Specializing in high-fidelity HTML5 game experiences with immersive systems and rich game-feel.

keyboard.Space: Dodge roll / wait a turn in Turn-Based mode
keyboard.Shift: Sprint while moving; use race ability while standing still
keyboard.1 / 2 / 3: Select Realtime, Chrono-Lock, or Turn-Based play from the game interface

touch.right side: Attack, block, class ability, and turn wait buttons

instructions: Choose a race, class, and temporal mode: Realtime, Chrono-Lock, or Turn-Based. Play a 10-mission campaign or endless procedural runs, collect Gold, and develop your LuckyStarShip through botany, exchange, repairs, and lore.
